events.title: Science at Sea: Adventure Beyond the Horizon
events.description: What does it take to explore the parts of our planet most of us will never see? Join ocean explorer and research-vessel professional Cody Bahlau for an evening inside the world of science at sea. Cody works aboard Columbia University’s research vessel R/V Marcus G. Langseth, where he helps plan and carry out scientific expeditions around the world. Through photographs, videos, stories, and firsthand experiences from life at sea, explore: * Life aboard a research vessel and what it is really like to spend weeks at sea, far from land * Exploring the seafloor, from mapping underwater landscapes to investigating what lies beneath them * Planning an expedition, from an idea on shore to the logistics, people, equipment, permits, and preparation required to send a research vessel to sea * The technology behind exploration, from satellites and sonar to miles of scientific equipment deployed behind a moving ship * Adventure and the unexpected, including rough seas, remote ports, equipment challenges, wildlife, international travel, and the realities of working on the open ocean And these stories are coming from closer to home than you might expect. Cody has called Gilpin County home for more than 20 years, while his work and curiosity have taken him on expeditions across the world’s oceans. From the mountains of Colorado to life and science at sea, his experiences are a reminder that exploration can begin anywhere.

events.title: Lunch Hour Book Discussion
events.description: This sprawling tale centers on Raja, a man in his sixties who lives with his mother in Beirut, a city shaking with political and ecological turmoil. Raja must weigh the responsibility he feels as a son against an opportunity to attend a writing residency in America. Raja’s energetic narration is relentlessly funny, even (or especially) when it’s turned to dark or disturbing events from his past. Copies will be available at the Circulation desk. Please contact Jen Matthews at mailto:jmatthews@gilpincounty.org jmatthews@gilpincounty.org mailto:jmatthews@gilpincounty.org with any questions about this book club.

events.title: Estate Planning Basics: Making Sure Your Assets Pass On to the Right People
events.description: Most people make the mistake of believing that an Estate Plan is only necessary for the wealthy. But if you have any assets, property, or possessions, and if you don’t want the state to make decisions for you, Estate Planning is essential. The Estate Planning principles that are covered in this forum are things you can do on your OWN to ensure your assets are transferred to the right individuals. Below are important questions and topics that will be covered in this class – * How You Can Do This On Your Own * The Benefits of Estate Planning * What is a Will * What is Probate * How to Set Up Beneficiaries on Accounts & Property * Should I Establish a Trust

events.description: Join us for popcorn and a movie as we preview early predictions for the 99th Academy Awards.
